title: Japan 5-year JGB auction (¥2,500bn anticipated) — the auction that opens the 2031-09-20 maturity two other tracked events are predicted to carry
source: EST: mof.go.jp English October 2026 auction calendar (english/policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2610e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 24,855 bytes) — parsed cell by cell, its table row reads 'Oct. 14, 2026 | 5-year'. Both the Auction Announcement and Auction Result cells are the plain string 'Detail' with no href, so nothing about this auction has been published yet; MOF's 5-year announcements publish exactly seven calendar days ahead (holiday-adjusted), so its terms should publish about 2026-10-07. NO SIZE IS ASSERTED — ¥2,500bn is the anticipated base case from MOF's own announcement pages auct20260702e.htm, auct20260810e.htm and auct20260901e.htm, each reading 'About 2,500 billion yen', plus auct20260511e.htm (HTTP 200, re-read 2026-09-09 for the same-maturity comparison in the proposing ledger) reading the same for the 2026-05-18 auction. Filed `estimate` on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office; the date is MOF's own and is not in doubt. Discovered 2026-09-09 during the never-assessed initial research of jgb-climate-transition-5y-auction-2026-11-02
notes: Discovered 2026-09-09 during the never-assessed initial research of jgb-climate-transition-5y-auction-2026-11-02, on MOF's own October calendar. It sits D-19 from the proposing event — well outside the ±5-day corridor, and proposed on evidence and on a named dependency rather than on proximity. THE MEASURED REASON IT IS WORTH TRACKING: it is the auction that OPENS the 2031-09-20 maturity, and two tracked ledgers have each independently registered a forward test that this maturity is what their own event will carry — jgb-5y-auction-2026-11-12 (FT-jgb-5y-auction-2026-11-12-2, from a 103-of-103 maturity-day rule and a 34-of-35 quarter map) and this proposal's own proposer (FT-jgb-climate-transition-5y-auction-2026-11-02-2, from a 5-of-5 same-quarter same-maturity identity between the GX 5-year and the regular 5-year). Its result page is the FIRST primary that can settle either, 19 days before the GX auction and 29 before the regular one, and BOTH of those forward tests name it explicitly as a kill switch. It is also the third-to-last Japanese coupon auction before the 2026-10-30 BoJ decision, so it is the cleanest pre-BoJ 5-year read on the calendar. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is low for the reason every sibling JGB ledger records: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
